Sub: Audio-video recording of the Press/Analyst / Institutional Investor Call 
This is in continuation of our letter dated 15th April, 2026 providing advance intimation of the 
Press / Analyst / Institutional Investor Call scheduled and held today, i.e., 20th April, 2026 at                 
5:30 P.M. (IST), and our letter dated 20th April, 2026 submitting the Presentation for the said 
meet. 
We also wish to inform you that the Company conducted the SML Mahindra Limited                       
Q4 FY 2025-26 Earnings Conference Call today with Press/Analyst/Institutional Investor through 
Audio-video mode which concluded at 06:20 P.M. 
We further inform you that the audio-video recording of the said meeting has been uploaded on 
the Company’s website and can be accessed at the following link:
